name: Shadow Lash
description: Four pillars manifest shadow lashes that attack intruders.
disable: DC 46 Arcana check (legendary) to drain the magic from each shadow lash or DC 48 Thievery check (legendary) to disable each shadow lash
routine: (8 actions) This trap loses 2 actions each turn for each disabled shadow lash. Each shadow lash has 2 actions it can use to perform the following actions.

offensiveAbilities.name: Long-Rage Lash
offensiveAbilities.description: The lash lengthens, increasing its reach to 60 feet, and makes a lash Strike. The lash's length then reverts to normal.

offensiveAbilities.name: Manifest
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature other than Kemnebi enters the chamber

Effect Four pillars manifest a writhing whip composed of solidified shadows. The trap then rolls initiative.
